description: The landed test runtime_staticlib_selection_ignores_decoy_newer_mtime_archive exercises the real parse fn but its decoy-mtime file is not load-bearing (the fn never touches the fs anymore). Two real ambiguity corners are untested: (a) >1 compiler-artifact with target.name==fz_runtime in one build stream (find_map takes first -- harmless by construction but assert it), (b) zero matching artifact messages (ok_or_else at aot_link.rs:281 errors -- assert the loud failure). Cheap coverage.
title: fz-0lm: add unit tests for runtime_staticlib_from_cargo_messages multi-artifact and zero-artifact corners
